title: capitulation is close
speaker: Matt (TB Matt)

macro_themes.theme: Market hinges on crude and yields
macro_themes.view: Range-bound market until the Iran war ends; lower crude would ease 10-year yields and help stocks.
TLT looks like a capitulation low; a rates pullback would be the release valve for equities and small caps.
Breadth is horrendous but so washed out that a counter-trend bounce is reasonable.
Fed pause odds for October rising to ~63%; strong ADP/GDP mean Fed focuses on inflation, which depends on crude.
